name: issue-triage
title_zh: 开源仓库的看门人：自动分诊 issue、查重
tagline_zh: 面对堆积如山的 issue 无从下手？它替你分类、找重复、关联 PR、评估风险，还能自动回帖。一次跑完。
tagline_en: Drowning in open issues? It sorts, dedupes, links PRs, flags risks, and drafts replies. One pass, clear backlog.
desc_en: Issue triage: audit open issues, categorize, detect duplicates, cross-ref PRs, risk assessment, post comments. Args: "all" for deep analysis of all, issue numbers to focus (e.g. "42 57"), "en"/"fr" for language, no arg = audit only in French.
why_zh: 不是简单打标签，而是跨 issue 与 PR 做语义关联，能发现人类容易漏掉的重复报告和潜在风险。
why_en: Goes beyond labels: cross-references issues and PRs semantically to catch duplicates and risks humans miss, slashing maintainer.
limit_zh: 只针对 GitHub 仓库的 issue 与 PR 文本分析，不处理代码内容。
limit_en: GitHub issues/PRs text only, no code analysis. Needs history for dedupe. Auto-comments require manual approval.
title_en: GitHub issue triage: categorize, dedupe, link PRs, assess.
